prompts: Wide low-angle landscape shot from a fixed camera position on a street clearing in a near-future endless city at dusk, cold high-contrast colour, deep blue shadows and dim amber sky. A thin, long-faced young man with prominent cheekbones, short black hair pressed flat by a helmet crease, a small scar at the end of his left eyebrow, wearing a dark grey hooded work jacket, black cargo trousers, a fluorescent orange delivery terminal hanging on his chest, a black half-finger glove on his right hand and worn sneakers, stands alone at the centre of the open lot. He looks down at the glowing orange terminal in his hands, then slowly lifts his head. As his gaze rises, the entire tall building wall directly in front of him slides sideways out of frame, grinding open to reveal a dense reordered cluster of towers behind; the camera pans slightly right, tracking the moving wall. Dust drifts in the dusk light.

A lean young man with a long narrow face, prominent cheekbones, short black hair flattened by helmet marks, and a small scar at the end of his left eyebrow, wearing a dark grey hooded work jacket, a fluorescent orange delivery terminal on his chest, black cargo pants, black fingerless gloves on his right hand, and worn sneakers, sprints through a cleared street space in a near-future endless city at dusk. Two towering building walls suddenly slide together from both sides, metal grinding. He brakes hard, pivots, and stumbles backward as a new facade pushes him back to his starting spot. Handheld medium shot from behind his left shoulder, camera shaking heavily, cold high-contrast blue-grey light, 832x480 landscape.

A close-up, static camera shot at a low angle in a near-future endless city street at dusk. A lean young man with a long thin face, prominent cheekbones, short black hair pressed with helmet marks, and a small scar at the end of his left eyebrow, wearing a dark grey hooded work jacket, black cargo pants, a fluorescent orange delivery terminal on his chest, and a black fingerless glove on his right hand, stands panting. He stares up at towering buildings, then lowers his head to the terminal as a grey soundwave icon glows on the screen. His brow tightens. The camera slowly pushes in on his face and chest terminal. Cold, high-contrast dusk lighting with deep shadows. The city feels folded and oppressive.

In a near-future endless city at dusk, a medium shot from a low angle circles slowly around a crouching man in the shadow at the base of a massive building. The man is lean-faced with prominent cheekbones, short black hair pressed with helmet marks, a small scar at the end of his left eyebrow; he wears a dark grey hooded work jacket, black cargo pants, a fluorescent orange delivery terminal on his chest, a black half-finger glove on his right hand, and old sneakers. He stares at glowing tick marks on the ground. The building begins to sink half a meter with a low rumble. He lowers his body, muscles tensed. As the building gap is about to close, he sprints forward and dives through. Cold high-contrast lighting, dusk tones, urban folding aesthetic, 832x480 landscape.

A lean, long-faced young man with prominent cheekbones, short black hair flattened by a helmet, a small scar at the tail of his left eyebrow, wearing a dark grey hooded work jacket, black cargo pants, a fluorescent orange delivery terminal on his chest, and a black fingerless glove on his right hand, stands in a narrow alley of a near-future endless city at dusk. He shoves a parcel into a glowing vertical seam between two towering concrete walls. The building slabs slam shut with a jolt, ejecting him backward; he flies through the air, the orange terminal torn from his chest and shattering on the ground, one old sneaker flying off. The camera, handheld and fixed initially, follows the parcel into the seam then whips down with him as he hits the pavement. Cold blue-grey dusk light, high contrast, deep shadows, 832x480 landscape, medium close shot, low angle. The shattered screen flickers: 'ORDER COMPLETE'. He lies still, exhausted, resigned.
